install:
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
ln -sf "$(python3 -c 'import shutil; print(shutil.which("uvicorn") or "")')" "$HOME/.local/bin/uvicorn" 2>/dev/null || true
start:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" CONFIG_PATH="${CONFIG_PATH:-./config}" PYTHONPATH=shared:services/core CIEM_ENV="${CIEM_ENV:-development}"
if [ -z "${CIEM_SECRET_KEY:-}" ] || [ "$CIEM_SECRET_KEY" = "change-me-in-production" ]; then echo "CIEM_SECRET_KEY obrigatória (secret do ambiente)"; exit 1; fi
exec python3 scripts/dev_serve_portal.py
